From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Exec intro + 60m technical deep dive (proposed windows)

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time today — really useful to understand the latency targets and where Finom is seeing throttling in peak hours. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone has the same context: 

- Primary objective: reduce 95th percentile inference latency from ~350ms to <120ms for the conversational product.
- Constraints: VPC-only deployment, DS encryption-at-rest, SOC 2 evidence required before pilot.
- Success criteria (pilot): 1) p95 latency below 120ms at target throughput, 2) end-to-end regression <2% on LLM quality tests, 3) reproducible cost baseline.

To keep momentum, we suggest an executive intro (15 min) immediately followed by a 45-minute technical deep dive/runbook demo. Proposed windows (all times in ET):

- Thu, May 14 — 10:00–11:00 AM ET
- Fri, May 15 — 2:00–3:00 PM ET
- Mon, May 18 — 11:00 AM–12:00 PM ET

Could you confirm which of these works for you and who from your side should join the exec portion (VP Eng / CTO)? On our side I’ll join the exec portion and loop in Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer) for the deep dive.

Attached: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (draft MAT), and a short pre-read in Drive (link below). I also attached the SOC2 questionnaire template we typically share — if you can return that ahead of the call it will speed procurement.

Notes / asks:
- Please share attendee names + titles for calendar invite.
- If an NDA is required before sharing the runbook, flag that and we’ll expedite.
- Any additional compliance artifacts needed for review?

I’ll hold the Fri May 15 slot tentatively until I hear back (no calendar invite yet).

Thanks —
Irene
